bullets.text: Built React.js frontend components from Figma designs and integrated them with Node.js backend REST APIs for My Surgical Risk, a clinical web application predicting postoperative surgical risk
Worked with real-time backend systems using Kafka (streaming) and Redis (caching); managed clinical data with Cassandra DB and containerized the application using Docker
Implemented authentication upgrades and password recovery functionality, improving security and usability for clinical staff
Researched novel graph algorithms for smart city routing problems, tackling the NP-complete Hamiltonian path challenge of visiting every location in a city-scale graph

Reframed the problem using Eulerian paths — traversing every edge (road) exactly once rather than every vertex — replacing NP-complete hardness with a computationally efficient, always-solvable alternative
Delivered a practical, scalable solution for real-world smart city use cases (e.g., garbage collection, road inspection) where full road coverage matters more than avoiding vertex revisits

Built a Natural Language to SQL Query system (React, Go, Python LLM microservice) letting non-technical users query any structured dataset in plain English; applicable across finance, healthcare, and e-commerce
Designed the Go backend as four decoupled modules (Analyzer, Generator, Validator, Executor) enforcing schema compliance and safety before execution; built for the UF CISE Software Engineering course

Implemented query caching and input sanitization to prevent SQL injection; Built a natural language-to-SQL system with query validation and safety checks, supporting multiple databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite

Engineered an ML pipeline predicting ICU sepsis risk up to 6 hours before clinical onset using ensemble models (Random Forest, XGBoost) trained on patient vitals and lab data with end-to-end feature engineering
Evaluated with AUROC and precision-recall curves to minimize false negatives in a high-stakes clinical setting; built a real-time risk score dashboard for clinician use

Deployed model as a REST API (FastAPI) with an interactive Streamlit dashboard; applied SHAP explainability to surface top contributing features per prediction, supporting clinical trust and interpretability

Built an open-source system that converts raw longitudinal EHR data into structured 4-hour time-bin timelines and applies temporal sequence models (GRU, Transformer) to predict 30-day readmission and 48-hour ICU mortality risk

Engineered a full explainability layer with feature attribution and natural language explanations tied to specific time windows; evaluated using AUROC, AUPRC, and Brier score; designed for compatibility with MIMIC-IV

Deployed a full-stack system (Next.js, FastAPI, PyTorch, Docker Compose) serving real-time predictions via REST API with Swagger docs; built a synthetic EHR data generator to support open development without requiring MIMIC-IV access
